title: ReadableField
summary: Copying now has real feedback: the Copy icon cross-fades into a green check (180ms), the change is announced to screen readers, and if the browser refuses the copy the icon turns into a red cross for 2 seconds and the value is selected so Cmd/Ctrl+C works. The whole value is selected with one click. The button keeps its 18 x 18 size throughout.
why: GitHub, Linear and Stripe swap the copy icon for a check with a cross-fade and keep the button size fixed; swapping mounted/unmounted icons caused the old pop.
WAI-ARIA practice (and React Aria's copy examples) announce 'Copied' through a status region because label changes on a focused button are not reliably spoken.
A silent catch hid clipboard failures (insecure contexts, denied permission); showing the failure and selecting the text gives the user a way forward.

scenarioLabels.copy-frames: Copying (frame samples: icon opacity and scale)
scenarioLabels.copy-failed: Copy failed: red cross, value selected

motion.before: Copy unmounted, Check mounted with a fade/zoom keyframe that never ran (values reset): instant swap
motion.after: Both icons always rendered in one 18 x 18 box; Copy goes opacity 1 to 0 and scale 1 to .8 while Check goes 0 to 1 and .8 to 1, 180ms, --v2-ease-spring (a sampled critically damped spring; in Figma use a custom spring or Smart Animate 'Gentle' / bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
Cross-fade to a red X (same 180ms), value text selected, held 2000ms, then back to Copy

states: Copy button / default (Copy icon, muted #707070), hover (--v2-text-primary #484848), pressed (scale 96%)
Copy button / copied: Check icon, --semantic-success-primary (unchanged colour), aria-label 'Copied'
Copy button / failed (new): X icon, --semantic-error-primary, aria-label 'Copy failed'
figmaSteps: Copy button: fix the button frame at 18 x 18 and stack three 18px icons in it (Copy, Check, X), all centred. Only one is visible per state.

States: default = Copy (opacity 100%, scale 100%), others 0% and 80%. Copied = Check 100% / 100% in --semantic-success-primary, others 0% / 80%. Failed (new) = X 100% / 100% in --semantic-error-primary (use the error/primary token), others 0% / 80%.
Prototype each change as Smart Animate 180ms, Gentle spring (bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Copied and Failed return to default after 2000ms (After delay).
Failed variant of the whole field: the value text shows a selection highlight (select-all). In Figma add a text selection fill on the value layer for this variant.
Value text: add the annotation 'user-select: all (one click selects the whole value)'. Pressed state: button scale 96%, 80ms down / 180ms back (unchanged).
Accessibility annotation: a visually hidden status 'Copied' / 'Copy failed' is announced politely; the button's label changes to 'Copied' / 'Copy failed'.
notes: A masked secret is not selected on failure (it would select the dots); the failed icon still shows. Revealing the value on failure was considered and not done because it changes what is on screen.
A Clipboard fallback (document.execCommand('copy') after selecting) would make copying work in insecure contexts; not added because it changes behaviour. Proposed follow-up.

onValueCopy is now called outside the failure path, and a throwing callback no longer flips a successful copy into a failed state (before it was silently swallowed with the copied state already set; the copied state is still kept).
The status region is always rendered (sr-only) but is empty until a copy happens, so no visible or queried text is duplicated: getByText for the value and label still finds one element.
The 'pressed' before image was recorded from a temporary copy of the previous component, so its page layout is not centred like the after image.
